method: AI-generated photographic cutout illustrations, arranged in original 4 by 2 atlases
localGpu: Unavailable during this run; no local GPU job was submitted
transformation: PNG sources encoded to WebP quality 82 with alpha preserved; occupied alpha bounds used for cropping
actualPhotos: Existing supplied product photos always take precedence; 176 generated images are used across 179 catalogue entries
disclosure: AI-generated product illustrations; appearance may differ from actual stock.
representation: Photographic cutouts in the existing 3D shops, not multi-view scans or verified stock photography
catalogue: Existing names, rates, sample notices, units and product data are preserved
